2608.04975.title: SciCode-Verified: How Benchmark Defects Underestimated the Scientific-Coding Ability of Language Models
2608.04975.paper_summary: SciCode is the standard measure of the scientific-coding ability of language models: research-level problems that demand both frontier scientific theory and its implementation as working numerical code. It is a component of the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and a standing evaluation in government and national-laboratory suites. Yet its scores have recently plateaued: the strongest 2026 models cluster tightly around 60\% subproblem accuracy, and a successor model ties its predecessor. We trace this stagnation to defects in the benchmark itself. A per-problem, domain-expert audit of all 65 test problems uncovers 263 defects; 192 of them, spread across 91\% of the main problems, cause correct, instruction-following solutions to be wrongly rejected---through non-reproducible gold answers, over-tight tolerances, or self-contradictory specifications. Critically, 78\% of these score-suppressing defects require specialized physics or mathematics knowledge to detect, not mere clerical proofreading. We corrected every confirmable defect to produce SciCode-Verified. The corrections add only the specifications a well-posed problem requires, repair grading, and tighten the tests that were too lenient; every change is recorded with its justification and independently re-checked by a second domain expert. We re-evaluate twelve frontier model snapshots on the corrected benchmark and find a substantial recovery: subproblem accuracy rises from 45--60\% to 84--98\%, and main-problem accuracy from 9--27\% to 69--92\%. State-of-the-art models are far more proficient in scientific coding than SciCode has suggested---the bottleneck was not model capability, but the quality of the evaluation instrument. We release SciCode-Verified with its complete audit trail as the corrected public standard.
2608.04975.paper_summary_zh: SciCode 是語言模型科學編碼能力的標準衡量指標：需要前沿科學理論及其作為可運行數值代碼的實施的研究級問題。<lb/>它是人工分析智能指數的一部分，也是政府和國家實驗室套件中的常規評估。<lb/>然而，其分數最近已經停滯：最強的 2026 模型的子問題準確率緊密集中在 60\% 附近，而後繼模型的表現與前任持平。<lb/>我們將這一停滯歸因於基準本身的缺陷。<lb/>對所有 65 個測試問題進行的逐個問題、領域專家的審核揭示了 263 個缺陷；其中 192 個分佈在 91\% 的主要問題上，導致正確的、遵循指令的解決方案被錯誤拒絕——這是由於不可重現的金標準答案、過於嚴格的容差或自相矛盾的規範。<lb/>關鍵是，78\% 的這些抑制分數的缺陷需要專業的物理或數學知識來檢測，而不僅僅是文書校對。<lb/>我們修正了每一個可確認的缺陷，以產生 SciCode-Verified。<lb/>這些修正僅增加了良好設置問題所需的規範，修復了評分，並收緊了過於寬鬆的測試；每一項變更都有其理由記錄，並由第二位領域專家獨立重新檢查。<lb/>我們在修正後的基準上重新評估了十二個前沿模型快照，發現了顯著的恢復：子問題準確率從 45--60\% 上升到 84--98\%，主要問題準確率從 9--27\% 上升到 69--92\%。<lb/>最先進的模型在科學編碼方面的能力遠超 SciCode 所暗示的——瓶頸並不是模型的能力，而是評估工具的質量。<lb/>我們發布了 SciCode-Verified，並附上完整的審核記錄，作為修正後的公共標準。
